relation_specs.definition: Target is effectively inevitable given the source event.
Target would not have happened without source; source alone need not guarantee target.

layer01.coreference: Group only mentions of the same real-world event.
layer01.recall_policy: FROZEN v1.4 behavior; reuse its validated exact-span inventory when available, otherwise execute the unchanged v1.4 extractor.
layer01.coreference_policy: keep singleton mention endpoints during extraction to avoid destructive under-merging; posthoc maps span to gold cluster
layer01.rescue_policy: after generative extraction, verify a source-only over-complete lexical candidate pool, then perform one final missed-event review
layer01.span_repair: repair only against visible source tokens; no gold IDs/types/relations

layer02.event_input: all frozen v1.4 event mentions; keep mention anchors distinct and do not delete or merge Layer-1 inventory
layer02.candidate_pool: three complementary high-recall whole-document directed graph proposals (PRECONDITION dependency, process/goal structure, direct cause/result) plus bounded source-cue rescue
layer02.precondition_semantics: target depends on source as prerequisite/enabling/initiating/supporting condition; strong implicit plan/process/purpose structure can count when document-grounded; do not require literal counterfactual wording
layer02.adjudication: single calibrated directed adjudicator; no skeptic cascade; accept DIRECT or STRONG_IMPLICIT positives above provenance-aware confidence threshold
layer02.direction: semantic causal/dependency direction only; never textual mention order
layer02.opposite_direction: prefer stronger direction; retain near-tied supported directions rather than reject both
layer02.gold: unavailable to all pipeline stages; stage recall diagnostics are computed only post-L12

gold_policy: Gold event clusters and causal relations are loaded only after Layer 12.
